propositions: The caused_by auto-derivation fallback produces no provenance marker distinguishing derived edges from explicitly supplied ones, making error rate unobservable; a marker is required for consumers to weight confidence appropriately.
On 88 closed bugs with caused_by edges, the deriver reproduces the recorded edge in 43% of cases, contradicts it in 7%, and abstains in 50% (33 no-majority, 8 no-file-impact, 3 no-fixing-commit).

Against independently proven origins (n=8), the deriver reproduced zero correct attributions, confidently named the wrong culprit once, and fail-closed in seven cases; the one confident miss occurred where consumer code was provably innocent.

The dominant defect shapes in this codebase (unmet obligations, carrier commits, omissions) are structurally hard for file-level blame and produce abstention rather than misattribution in most cases, validating the fail-closed design.
